title: Personnel.
bodyText:
PART VI. GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

The administrator of the state agency shall hire necessary personnel under chapter 76 to carry out the purposes of this chapter.

PART VI.  GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

 

Note
